headline: Kyle Cooke call read: 7 out of 10, deal parked on proof.

calls.title: Kyle Cooke, closing call
calls.read: Strong discovery and clean objection isolation: the block is proof, not price, and the prospect accepted a 10k one pay outright. Two leaks: about 15 minutes of the mechanism taught for free mid call, and a payment split offered after the price had already landed. Follow up was booked inside 24 hours, which is right. The follow up loop is still open in the sheet; close it.
calls.fix: Build the proof vault before the next pitch this size: interviews plus fresh selfie testimonials in one Drive folder, sent within the hour of any call that asks. Now doctrine: Operator Playbook v6, RYAN-VERIFIED 2026-08-06.
